ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Central Bank of India disclosed a three-day technical glitch in its critical RTGS outward system from October 15-17, 2026. While the bank asserts no customer suffered financial loss and immediately isolated affected systems, this incident highlights potential operational vulnerabilities in a core banking service. The ongoing analysis to ascertain the root cause is a material red flag, indicating an unresolved issue that requires robust corrective measures to prevent future disruptions.
